C-R3-MINIMAL-MEETING-321.IntentSummary: Move document-generation setup to the moment it is needed: create the authoritative meeting from minimal domain identity, preserve any existing reusable defaults, and resolve only the template for the requested output kind.

T-000.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: fix the meeting stages and minimum data

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Actor: staff member preparing a department meeting; trigger: New meeting; authoritative object: meeting; minimum create data: date and protocol number; agenda follows immediately; document-template exceptions are deferred to generation.
The imported-protocol path remains separate and unchanged.

T-001.Title: kafedra-data: reuse nullable meeting snapshots without migration

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No schema change is needed because chair, secretary, quorum and template-version meeting fields are already nullable.
The configured create path is reused unchanged; only meeting_settings_incomplete falls back to available nullable defaults and null profile snapshots.
Historical snapshots and generated meeting_documents are never rewritten.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: keep create minimal and defer only the missing output template

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop and mobile create forms ask only for date and protocol number; focus starts on the first meaningful field and no setup modal is forced.
If generation lacks a deterministic template, one compact dialog asks only for the template of that document kind and keeps the original action understandable.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: use no-motion for create and generation disclosure

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No new animation or gesture is introduced; existing modal/focus behavior is reused.
prefers-reduced-motion needs no special branch because the new flow has no motion dependency.

T-004.Title: kafedra-feature: implement minimal meeting creation and per-kind template resolution

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The existing configured create/generate implementations remain the first path; flexible fallback is used only when full meeting settings or a deterministic output template are absent.
Generation fallback resolves meeting snapshot → explicit choice → saved setting → default catalog entry → single ready catalog entry for the requested kind.
A missing extract template cannot block protocol generation and a missing protocol template cannot block extract generation.
Existing request hash, meeting_documents.template_version_id and audit provenance remain authoritative.
After create the exact meeting is open and Add question is immediately available; no template, chair, secretary or quorum interruption appears.
Desktop/mobile keyboard flow remains usable and the generation exception dialog exposes one decision instead of the full settings form.

T-006.Title: kafedra-tests: prove empty-install meeting and unchanged snapshot history

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit/integration covers empty settings create→agenda, existing complete-settings copy, protocol-only template generation and ambiguous template selection.
Browser regression covers New meeting → date/number → open meeting → add agenda without opening Settings.
